## prompt-4-final-paper

*Generated by Process A from [`../prompts/prompt-paper.md`](../prompts/prompt-paper.md),
adapting `trial-protocol/sub-prompts/prompt-4-final-protocol.md` to the paper build
(paper v1.0, repository v4.2.0). Runs in stage `trial-documents/final-paper/`. No
`publication` subdirectory is created (Rule).*

Author the **Stage 4 final paper** of *Phase 1 Pancreatic Cancer Trial Efficient
LLM Document Generations* into `trial-documents/final-paper/`.

**Goal.** Reach maximum context and formatting quality. Double-verify that all
context and formatting is improved from the full paper, and implement every
correction identified in the full stage.

**Files (Rule 6, one commit each).** `main.tex`, `paperstyle.sty`,
`references.bib`, `README.md`, then one commit per section `.tex` (the same eight
section files).

**Senior-author formatting (learn and implement from
`trial-protocol/final-protocol/publication`).**
- Start each major section on a fresh page with `\clearpage` so each section is
  self-standing; avoid a single line stranded on the next page.
- Apply `\vspace` and `\hspace` adjustments around figures and tables for even
  vertical rhythm; `raggedbottom` so pages are not vertically stretched.
- Tune table column widths to the body measure; every width value is prepended
  with `\raggedright\arraybackslash`; each table matches `\textwidth` exactly.
- Modify `\RaggedRight` spacing so interword spacing is even and no text runs off
  the right margin; break long URLs on any character so no link runs off the page.
- Avoid lines of a single or two words; add or remove relevant text so each
  section and page is properly formatted and self-standing without overcrowding.
- Correct all incorrect symbols (for example, render the section symbol as §) and
  use single dashes only - no em dashes, double dashes, or triple dashes.
- References compile with clickable URLs and clickable DOI URLs; both the DOI and
  the DOI URL appear where relevant; no link runs off the right side.

**Figures.** Re-verify every TikZ figure for no overlaps, correct arrow looseness,
and proper box spacing; expand the two densest figures to full fidelity.

**Commit schedule (Rules 6, 7, 8).** One commit per file in real time (10+
commits). The second-to-last commit fixes all remaining errors. The last commit
writes `sections/README.md`, `output-final-paper.md`, `final-paper-LaTeX.zip`, and
performs the remaining repository updates (root `README.md`, `releases.md`,
`CHANGELOG.md` at v4.2.0; `prompts/output-paper.md`). Do not stall, ask questions,
or go into plan mode.
